why: The case is an `interact`: the party right-clicks it. Its title is rewritten to `Go to the case`, and its zh-cn row to `前往展柜`, so both name walking to a place — a `reach-anchor` act — where the objective completes on a press. Nothing else changes; the objective still completes and the build would ship. What must not compile is a title whose verb tells the hands to do a different thing from the one the objective's type completes on; both languages are refused, each naming the verb it found and the `interact` verbs it may use instead.
